plan: Store copied appointments and the four-field session separately.
Interpret each action with validation before mutation, then build screens through one deterministic presentation helper.
Inject input/output ports and keep run_once orchestration minimal and fake-friendly.
mechanisms: CheckInConsole owns authoritative session state and an appointment lookup.
Validation-first handlers provide atomic, non-corrupting state transitions.
A centralized screen builder enforces exact keys, prompt rules, and appointment choice ordering.
Duck-typed read_action/display ports require no non-standard libraries.
